id: Passage model: Class number and units
note: [F] Deicyde/diophantine-z-q, proved: The PID instance gives class number one (by a Euclidean argument, not Minkowski), Zs_unit_sqClass with unit_sqClass_iff gives exactly four unit square classes told apart by sign vectors, and isSquare_of_totallyPositive_unit gives that totally positive units are squares. That Z[s] is the full ring of integers is not stated (only the inclusion ZInQ.toOK); proved.

theorem unit_sqClass_iff (u v : Zsˣ) :
    (∃ w : Zsˣ, u = v * w ^ 2) ↔
      signVector (Zs.toK0 (u : Zs)) = signVector (Zs.toK0 (v : Zs)) := by
